editorial.name: Optimizely
editorial.descriptionZh: 面向市场和数字化团队的 AI 平台：Agentic CMS 管内容、Agentic Experimentation 做测试与个性化、Agent Platform 跑 agent 任务，另有一块专门优化内容在大语言模型里的呈现。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把内容、实验、agent 三条线并到一套营销平台上
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是海边黄昏的照片，中间一位卷发模特，头顶压着荧光绿、叠了十几层立体阴影的标题 You're free to grow，左侧绿色小字写 The AI platform to create and optimize every digital experience. So the experience-makers can do the work they love.，配一枚 Let's grow 按钮。紧下面一条青色横幅 Save your spot at，把自家大会排成 NYC SEPT 1 | LONDON OCT 13 | ONLINE OCT 21。正文三块是 Let your creators create / Turn traffic into revenue / Put AI agents to work，分别对应 Agentic CMS、Agentic Experimentation、Agent Platform；再往后 One platform. Three paths to growth. 把 Marketer Experience、Customer Experience、Agent Experience 拆成三条，其中 Agent Experience 写的是 Monitor, measure and optimize how your content is used by your newest customer: large language models.。
editorial.pricing: unknown（导航有 Plans & pricing，首页只给 Let's grow / Get started）

reasons.statement: 页面交付的是 Optimizely 这套平台的三大产品线与 Let's grow / Get started 入口，导航分 Products / Solutions / Resources / Plans，按产品与公司官网归入单站展示。
